title: Halo — smart lamp launch spot
storyboard:
# Halo — smart lamp launch spot

Length 10 seconds at 30 fps. Deliver two cuts: 16:9 (1920x1080), 9:16 (1080x1920).

## Shot 1 (0:00–0:03) Product hero
- A round white smart lamp glows warm amber in a dark, minimal living room.
- The lamp is fully inside the frame by 0:01.
- Caption reads exactly: Light that listens
- The caption is fully visible by 0:01.

## Shot 2 (0:03–0:06) Colour
- The lamp's glow shifts from amber to soft blue.
- A price tag reads exactly: $89 and is visible at 0:04 and at 0:05.

## Shot 3 (0:06–0:10) Call to action
- The HALO wordmark is visible throughout shot 3.
- A button labelled exactly: Pre-order now, fully visible by 0:08.
- On the 9:16 cut, no text or button sits in the bottom 35% or the top 14% of the frame.
- On every cut, all text stays fully inside the frame.

versions.summary: First composition: lamp hero, listening rings, amber→blue colour dial, HALO CTA; per-aspect layouts
Sequential price→wordmark handoff (no overlap at 0:05.8); larger 9:16 button
Client change: 16:9 CTA becomes a full-width buy bar docked to the bottom edge; 9:16 keeps the in-band pill (storyboard forbids buttons in bottom 35%)

I added a comment block at the top of `video/Video.tsx` listing the three shots with their timecodes, frame ranges and what each one shows:

- **Shot 1, 0:00–0:03 (frames 0–89):** Product hero
- **Shot 2, 0:03–0:06 (frames 90–179):** Colour
- **Shot 3, 0:06–0:10 (frames 180–299):** Call to action

It's only a comment, so the video itself is unchanged and I didn't run another review. The Stop hook will still re-check the file when I stop.

I tightened the comment block at the top of `video/Video.tsx`. Each shot now takes one short line:

```
Halo launch spot — 10s, 30 fps, 300 frames; 16:9 + 9:16.

1  0:00–0:03  f0–89     Hero: amber lamp, "Light that listens"
2  0:03–0:06  f90–179   Colour: amber → blue, "$89" tag
3  0:06–0:10  f180–299  CTA: HALO wordmark, "Pre-order now"
```

Nothing else changed, so I didn't run another review.
Restore 9:16 button to the safe band (buttonY 0.86 → 0.475); out-of-band edit had moved it into the bottom 35%
Clip the lamp bloom inside a frame-sized glow layer so no lamp-related layer extends past the 9:16 frame
Keep the lamp's bloom and outer halo inside the frame so the visible lamp never meets the frame edge
